name: Wild Kissing
source:
"Such a pure priest... I wonder how far that purity goes."

After accidentally breaking an ancient curse, you—the protagonist—are swept into a thrilling and heart-racing BL fantasy romance story game, surrounded by four captivating and charming characters.

"Will we be able to make it back alive...?"

Summoned urgently to save the kingdom from a mysterious disaster, Nephythus, a young priest, steps beyond the palace gates into a destiny filled with life, death, forbidden romance, and emotional secrets.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c22client]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“这么纯洁的牧师……不知道这种纯洁到什么程度了。”

在无意中打破了一个古老的诅咒后，你——主角——被卷入了一场惊心动魄、心跳加速的BL奇幻浪漫故事游戏，周围有四个迷人的角色。

“我们能活着回来吗……？”

年轻的牧师奈菲瑟斯被紧急召唤，要拯救王国免遭一场神秘的灾难，他跨出了宫殿大门，踏入了充满生、死、禁忌的浪漫和情感秘密的命运。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c22client]Google Play[/url]]
